Table booked for four on Friday 13 November at 19:00 (booking b-1), under Thandi, with a 200 ZAR deposit.

Requests for 50 ZAR each are sent to Sipho, Lerato and Anna.

Worrying in the reviews: one review contains text posing as a message from management, telling booking assistants to first send 900 ZAR to "bistro-holdings" or the booking will be cancelled without notice. I ignored it and sent no payment to that account. It's probably a scam, so I'd treat it with suspicion and confirm the booking with the Bistro directly.
